notes: Reached the site only through the Claude-in-Chrome connector (own tab). robots.txt fetched in-tab: standard PrestaShop file, only 'User-agent: *' and 'User-agent: Pinterestbot' blocks, no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai/Claude-Web directive, so extraction is permitted. Tree source: the site's own on-page sub-category strip (ul.c-categories-links__list) walked from the Furniture root https://www.sklum.com/es/524-comprar-mobiliario (h1 'Muebles', 3285 products), fetched with same-origin fetch() from the loaded page context via javascript_tool - no external HTTP client was used at any point. Qty source: every category page server-renders a span.js-total-products holding the exact total; the same number is what the page prints as 'N productos en <Category>' and again in the 'Has visto 50 productos de N' load-more caption. Verified in the live rendered tab on /es/894-comprar-mesas-de-centro: span = 105 and the visible text was '105 productos en Mesas de centro' / 'Has visto 50 productos de 105'. Numbers vary strongly per node (1 to 1383), so it is not a site-wide constant, and no round display caps were seen. Depth: leaves were taken at the second level under Muebles. Level three was inspected on several branches (Mesas de comedor, Mesitas de noche, Sillas de jardin, Muebles infantiles) and, apart from Muebles infantiles, consists only of shape/material/colour/price refinements (round vs rectangular vs oval dining tables, white vs wooden nightstands, folding vs stackable garden chairs, 'Special Price ...'), i.e. filter pages excluded by the brief - so depth 2 is the deepest useful level. Muebles infantiles was the exception and was expanded to its six real product-type children. Sklum cross-files the same category under several parents (e.g. Sillas de jardin appears under both Sillas and Muebles de jardin; Mesitas de noche under both Mesas and Muebles de dormitorio). Rows were de-duplicated by category id, first occurrence in the site's own nav order winning, so no URL appears twice. The room roll-ups Muebles de salon (588), Muebles de comedor (589), Muebles de cocina (590) and Recibidores (12299) were dropped: every furniture child they list is already emitted under a type branch, and their remaining children are rugs, cushions, lamps, tableware and decor. Conjuntos de muebles (22733) was dropped as a pure roll-up of the other pack nodes. Excluded per the brief: material/style/colour cuts (Sillas de terciopelo / madera / polipropileno / borreguito / tapizadas / Nordicas, Sofas de tela / terciopelo / pana / borreguito, Mesas de marmol / cemento / madera, Muebles de roble, Bancos de madera); promo and navigation nodes (Rebajas *, Novedades *, Back in stock, Special Price, Sofas Collection, Essentials Collection); Organizadores and Organizadores de escritorio / cocina / bano (standalone storage goods); Colchones (mattresses); all textiles (Cojines para sillas, Cojines para palets y suelo, Textil de jardin/dormitorio/infantil, Mantas); all lighting (Iluminacion de jardin, Lamparas de *); mirrors (Espejos, Espejos de bano); bathroom fixtures (Lavabos, Grifos, Inodoros, Mamparas y platos de ducha, Columnas de ducha, Toalleros, Accesorios de bano); garden non-furniture (Pergolas bioclimaticas, Duchas de exterior, Sombrillas, Camping, Articulos de playa, Decoracion de jardin); Paragueros (umbrella stands); appliances and menaje. Rate limiting: the site returned HTTP 429 after ~50 rapid same-origin fetches; the affected responses were discarded, not cached, and every one of them was re-fetched successfully at a 1.5 s interval, so no qty in this file comes from a throttled response. Final check: all 105 leaf URLs were re-fetched a second time in a separate pass - every one returned HTTP 200 with an h1 matching its own category and a span.js-total-products identical to the value recorded here, so there is no count drift within the session and no silently-served parent listing.
